allowed_exclusions: imbalance == 0 in side-dependent cells (the M2-0 execution filter)
rows whose label or arrival state is missing, counted per cell

contamination_and_limits.cost_limits: 2026 rate cards are applied to a 2019 tape to validate arithmetic and component ordering, not to reconstruct 2019 economics; the structural floor excludes commission, clearing, market data, slippage and impact
contamination_and_limits.day_status: 2019-07-30 remains DEVELOPMENT for the lifetime of the project and can never become a validation or sealed partition
contamination_and_limits.execution_limits: idealized aggressive fills (sufficient displayed size, immediate fill, no impact, no queue effect); the delay grid tests achievable arrival, not queueing
contamination_and_limits.multiple_testing: the declared state space is the only one examined; no threshold, horizon, universe, feature or model is selected on the proxy data, and no post-result cell may be promoted to a strategy claim
contamination_and_limits.proxy_limits: the liquidity decile and the large-tick screen use one day instead of a 60-trading-day lookback, so the proxy population is not membership and its composition would differ from a rule-conformant universe

data_versions.sealed_partition: NONE (a single day cannot support partitions; M2/output/calculations/split_manifest.json already records NO_SPLIT_POSSIBLE_INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE)

decision_if_negative: coverage approaches or exceeds the hurdle in the intended population => the aggressive branch is NOT killed; the binding unknown becomes the modern regime and price level, which only paid data can supply => EXTERNAL_BLOCK with a quantified purchase request (provider, product, scope, cost status), and no further development-day tuning.
decision_if_positive: coverage remains far below the hurdle in the intended population => the aggressive branch is KILLED, the modern-data purchase has no decision value for this hypothesis, and the M1 candidate table is updated (candidate moves from WEAK to DEAD with a resurrection condition). A passive-execution pivot is registered separately as a new candidate, not executed here.
decision_question: In a single-day proxy of the frozen universe's own population - large-tick, top-dollar-volume, Nasdaq-listed common stock - does the aggressive/abstain form of the candidate retain enough economic room to justify paying for a modern-regime dataset and a point-in-time security master, or is the branch economically dead on structural grounds?
execution_version: aggressive cross-in / cross-out at the far touch, arrival-time book, delay grid 0-1000 ms, representative order 100 shares; M2-0 definition, unchanged
feasibility_reference: NONE (M2-0.5's frozen-execution re-derivation is run-specific and cannot apply to a re-scoped run; the M2-0 defects D1/D2 stay recorded in M2/output/calculations/feasibility_status.json)
feature_version: I(t) = (Q_bid - Q_ask) / (Q_bid + Q_ask), displayed size at the best quotes, one-sided-or-zero excluded; M2-0 definition, unchanged
hypothesis: The economic infeasibility measured in M2-0.5 (aggressive queue-imbalance trading pays a 3.37 bps spread plus a 1.44 bps floor fee to harvest a 0.085 bps 1 s mid move) is a property of the intended population or an artifact of the M2-0 compute scope. The M2-0 compute scope is the top 61 Nasdaq-listed non-ETP common stocks ranked by order-add message count; its mean quoted spread is 4.82 ticks and only 58.65% of its observations sit at one tick, while the frozen universe rule NASDAQ-LARGETICK-QIMB-UNIV-v1 requires a one-tick median spread. The scope is therefore not large-tick and is not a population in which the candidate's own mechanism can be evaluated.
mechanism: Top-of-book displayed queue imbalance predicts the direction of the next midpoint move over 100 ms - 1 s. Aggressive monetization requires the predicted mid move to exceed the executed round trip: one full quoted spread plus venue and statutory fees.
multiple_testing_note: one proxy population, one declared state space, one decision rule; no threshold, horizon, universe, feature or model is selected on the proxy data
own_manifest: M2/experiments/M2-0-6-UNIVPROXY/run_inputs.json (written after the run; the M2-0 freeze_manifest stage writes fixed canonical paths and is deliberately not run for this pass)
permitted_post_result_decisions: KILLED / CONTINUE / PIVOT_JUSTIFIED / ADVANCE / EXTERNAL_BLOCK for the aggressive branch
recording the measured friction decomposition as durable evidence
registering a passive-execution candidate with an explicit fill-model specification (no aggressive-backtest reuse)
updating the M1 candidate table, DEAD_ENDS.md, the evidence ledger and PROJECT_STATE.md
requesting a written quote for modern Nasdaq order-level data and a point-in-time security master (a request, not a purchase)

population.not_claimed: universe membership, eligibility, coverage, listing history, corporate-action or halt screening, or any modern-regime claim
population.primary_analysis_population: large-tick proxy subset of the replay scope: per symbol, over the day's valid 1 s grid observations, median quoted spread equals exactly one tick AND fraction of valid observations at one tick >= THETA = 0.50 (the frozen rule's own large-tick sentences, applied to a one-day proxy of its 60-day lookback). Symbols with fewer than 1000 valid observations are excluded and counted.
population.scope_rule: top 120 by same-day venue trade-tape dollar volume (E executions priced at the resting order, C executions at their execution price, P non-cross trades; crosses counted, never priced) inside the single-day top decile of the frozen rule's liquidity variable, computed by M2/src/universe_proxy.py with the rule's own primitive universe.top_decile_by_dollar_volume
secondary_populations: the whole replay scope (for like-for-like comparison against the M2-0 figures)
the predeclared price bands (5-25, 25-50, 50-100, 100-200, 200+) and spread classes of the M2-0.5 state space

precommitted_decision_rule.G1_best: max over declared cells (>= 100 observations) of signal_multiple_T in the large-tick proxy subset, STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR
precommitted_decision_rule.G1_pooled: signal_multiple_T pooled over the large-tick proxy subset, STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR, best of the four preregistered horizons
precommitted_decision_rule.G2: ORACLE_UPPER_BOUND net of STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR, per trade at the same horizon
precommitted_decision_rule.alive_criterion: G1_best < 5.0 => the branch is not killed by this diagnostic; the binding unknown is the modern regime and price level, which needs paid data => EXTERNAL_BLOCK
precommitted_decision_rule.corroboration_required: G2 is reported and must be consistent with the verdict: if G1_best >= 5 but G2 per trade exceeds 5 bps, the automatic verdict is downgraded to CONTINUE and escalated as a written discrepancy rather than being applied silently
precommitted_decision_rule.decision_after_kill: update DEAD_ENDS.md, the M1 candidate table and the evidence ledger; register a passive-execution pivot as its own candidate and hypothesis if and only if a fill model is specified; stop the M2 run at its terminal state
precommitted_decision_rule.degenerate_case: if the large-tick proxy subset is empty or every cell has fewer than 100 observations, no verdict is issued from this experiment and the run reports INSUFFICIENT_PROXY_POPULATION
precommitted_decision_rule.kill_criterion: G1_best >= 5.0 AND G1_pooled >= 10.0 => KILLED. Rationale fixed in advance: the friction is already at its regulatory and pricing floor (one tick = the Reg NMS minimum for these securities, plus the exchange remove-liquidity fee and the statutory sale-side charges, with no broker layer); the only regime channel that changes the ratio is the per-second mid-move scale, whose plausible range around a 2019 low-volatility baseline is under about 3x, so a gap of 5x or more in the best declared cell cannot be closed by a regime change.

primary_metric.cell_grid: 10 imbalance bins x 2 spread classes x 5 price bands x 4 horizons (the M2-0.5 declared state space), plus the pooled and extreme-bin (|I| >= 0.8) views
primary_metric.definition: required_move_bps / signal_bps, where required_move_bps is the mean execution hurdle in the same cell (STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR round trip at the arrival price + the full quoted spread paid) and signal_bps is the mean side-signed mid move (side = sign of ex-ante queue imbalance) at the same horizon; both read from breakeven_hurdle.csv and feasibility_status.json produced by the frozen M2-0.5 code on the proxy replay
primary_metric.name: signal_multiple_T

prohibited_post_result_decisions: re-tuning thresholds, horizons, universes or bins on the proxy day
re-running M2-0's 100 ms configuration on the proxy scope to look for a better number
presenting the proxy population as universe membership
treating the 2019 day as a basis for a modern-regime claim in either direction
sampling_rule: one decision per symbol per second (grid_ns = 1 s), 09:30:00 to 16:00:00, causal as-of rule FILE_ORDER_LAST_MESSAGE_WITH_TS_LE_DECISION_TS; labels at 100/250/500/1000 ms; delay arrivals at 0/10/25/50/100/250/500/1000 ms
secondary_diagnostics: ORACLE_UPPER_BOUND net of STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR and of each ACCESSIBLE_REFERENCE_PATH schedule, per observation and per trade (the ceiling on any causal policy at these instants)
the mechanism decomposition by component (spread, floor fee, broker layer)
per-symbol and per-price-band dispersion, with block-bootstrap standard errors over symbol x 30-minute blocks
monotonicity of the imbalance-response relation, and the fraction of observations at one tick
sibling_reference: M2-0.5 (aggressive monetization feasibility bound, read-only analysis of M2-0)
